claims.statement: Human controls and WebMCP tools update the same visible dashboard state.
ChatGPT Site Tools can discover and invoke the application tools.

challenge.whyWebMCP: The agent and person need to inspect and update the same live dashboard rather than exchange detached summaries.
challenge.uxImprovement: The person can ask for a range change, watch the dashboard update, and continue editing through the existing controls.
challenge.humanAgentCapability: The agent can inspect plotted provenance, apply a date range, and return the resulting chart revision for human review.
challenge.implementation: Top-level document tools call the same dashboard actions used by the human controls and return compact JSON evidence.
